flags.why: The common use of quan hệ to mean having sex is missing, creating a risk of embarrassing misunderstandings ([source](https://thethaovanhoa.vn/chu-va-nghia-quan-he-quan-he-tinh-duc-20210324064036704.htm)).

In drama, lớp is a scene within an act, whereas hồi is an act ([source](https://tailieugiaovien.edu.vn/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/Gi%C3%A1o-%C3%A1n-V%C4%83n-9-ph%C3%A1t-tri%E1%BB%83n-n%C4%83ng-l%E1%BB%B1c-so%E1%BA%A1n-theo-5-ho%E1%BA%A1t-%C4%91%E1%BB%99ng.pdf)).
flags.fix: scene (a subdivision of an act in a play)

flags.why: The example incorrectly translates lớp as Act.
